authentication: No Earthdata token required for the public PDS route tested with a one-byte unauthenticated GET.

coverage_check.note: Declared rectangular bounds only; acquisition does not establish valid-pixel coverage or mineral classes.

required_metadata: Keep corresponding HDR, LBL/XML and, for spectral analysis, WV TAB/LBL. Metadata copies are in docs/investigacion-marte.
next_steps: Acquire bounded files, record complete SHA-256 and sizes; preserve metadata.
Check actual valid pixels and supplemental VNIR/IR mask inside the exact Jezero polygon.
Review selected spectral parameters or spectra; document indicators and false detections before identifying mineral classes.
Build a reviewed class correspondence with EMIT. Different instruments and class codes cannot be compared directly.

acquisition.local_state: Read the verified acquisition manifest or report; this source specification does not claim local file availability.

not_included: No mineral labels or cross-planet similarity published. Acquisition of raw products is tracked separately.
